card.name: Start of a capitalized name after the
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a word that begins a proper name or term, mostly a capital C or R, right after a word like the, James, Kim or First. It is mid-word, so the rest of the name has not appeared yet.

modes.label: Capital C starting a name
modes.description: A lone C or Car begins a person, place or team name in news-style text.
modes.example: 1856. The town of Florence, established in 1854, was built upon the site of Winter Quarters. James<< C>>. Mitchell and Associates of the Florence Land

modes.label: R starting a term
modes.description: An R or r begins a word like RSV or rations after a modifier.
modes.example: Recommended Dosage of BEYFORTUS for the First<< R>>SV Season Body Weight at Time of D

card.writes: It promotes 'round' forms and suppresses R-initial pieces, which does not match the contexts; the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a name or term just before the rest of the word is spelled out.
